other_conditions: Applicant must belong to Antodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH) ration cardholder families
Both bride and groom must be permanent residents of Ladakh
Marriage must be the first marriage for both parties
Bride must be above 18 years of age; groom above 21 years
Divyangjan applicants must have benchmark disabilities as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance of ₹50,000 to female beneficiaries and ₹1,00,000 to Divyangjan beneficiaries.
